name: Power Monitoring Division 1
description: This Division is staffed by workers tasked with monitoring power generation systems, marginally increasing power output at the cost of workforce. The generated power is restricted to only supporting lower-priority upgrades.

name: Power Monitoring Division 2
description: This Division is staffed by workers tasked with monitoring power generation systems, moderately increasing power output at the cost of workforce. The generated power is restricted to only supporting lower-priority upgrades.

name: Power Monitoring Division 3
description: This Division is staffed by workers tasked with monitoring power generation systems, significantly increasing power output at the cost of workforce. The generated power is restricted to only supporting lower-priority upgrades.

name: Workforce Mecha-Tooling 1
description: Limited Mecha-Tooling empowers workers, utilizing additional power to marginally increase workforce effectiveness. The generated workforce is restricted to local use, supporting only lower-priority upgrades within the same system.

name: Workforce Mecha-Tooling 2
description: Modest Mecha-Tooling empowers workers, utilizing additional power to moderately increase workforce effectiveness. The generated workforce is restricted to local use, supporting only lower-priority upgrades within the same system.

name: Workforce Mecha-Tooling 3
description: Extensive Mecha-Tooling empowers workers, utilizing additional power to significantly increase workforce effectiveness. The generated workforce is restricted to local use, supporting only lower-priority upgrades within the same system.

name: Exploration Detector 1
description: This limited detector allows ship scanners to pick up a few undetected relic and data signatures for probe scanning within a system.

name: Exploration Detector 2
description: This standard detector allows ship scanners to pick up a moderate number of undetected relic and data signatures for probe scanning within a system.

name: Exploration Detector 3
description: This advanced detector allows ship scanners to pick up many undetected relic and data signatures for probe scanning within a system.

name: Isogen Prospecting Array 1

name: Major Threat Detection Array 1
description: This array detects combat anomalies that contain some of the toughest hostiles in null security space, making it an excellent sovereignty hub upgrade for experienced combat pilots.

name: Major Threat Detection Array 2
description: This array detects combat anomalies that contain some of the toughest hostiles in null security space, making it an excellent sovereignty hub upgrade for experienced combat pilots. This variant has a faster detection capability for new anomalies compared to its base version.

name: Major Threat Detection Array 3
description: This array detects combat anomalies that contain some of the toughest hostiles in null security space, making it an excellent sovereignty hub upgrade for experienced combat pilots. This variant detects new anomalies faster than the base and upgraded versions.

name: Minor Threat Detection Array 1

name: Advanced Logistics Network
description: This network enables the onlining of a Standup conduit generator at one Ansiblex jump bridge structure in the system.

name: Cynosural Navigation
description: This upgrade enables the onlining of a Standup cynosural field generator at one Pharolux cyno beacon structure in the system.

name: Cynosural Suppression
description: This upgrade enables the onlining of a Standup cynosural system jammer at one Tenebrex cyno jammer structure in the system.

name: Supercapital Construction Facilities
description: These facilities enable the onlining of Standup supercapital shipyards at any Sotiyo -class engineering complexes in the system.

name: Electric Stability Generator
description: This generator produces system-wide effects similar to those encountered in Electric environments within Abyssal Deadspace. All ships in system: 25% bonus to Capacitor recharge rate, +25% targeting range and Directional Scanner range.

name: Exotic Stability Generator
description: This generator produces system-wide effects similar to those encountered in Exotic environments within Abyssal Deadspace. All ships in system: +25% scan resolution, +2 AU/s warp speed.

name: Gamma Stability Generator
description: This generator produces system-wide effects similar to those encountered in Gamma environments within Abyssal Deadspace. All ships in system: +5% Shield HP, +5% Local Shield Booster Effectiveness, +10% Capacitor capacity

name: Plasma Stability Generator
description: This generator produces system-wide effects similar to those encountered in Plasma environments within Abyssal Deadspace. All ships in system: +5% Armor HP, +5% Local Armor Repairer Effectiveness, +10% bonus to the benefits of overloading modules.
